scenario_description: The sandboxed runtime still rejects a component that exits zero with invalid JSON shape.
expected: The source and adapter pass before the deliberately broken sink runs.
The sink exits zero but both exact schema errors are retained and the runtime remains incomplete.
Network preflight and exact container cleanup still pass on the failed workload.
observed: The source and adapter passed in the same sandbox before the broken sink executed.
The broken sink exited zero but output validation retained missing /report/title and /trace/source and kept all_steps_completed false.
Network and sensitive-name preflight passed and exact container cleanup still exited zero.
notes: PASS means the sandboxed verifier detected the deliberate green-exit invalid artifact; the broken pipeline itself failed as designed.
